body:
GREG DIRECT, 2026-11-04 about 16:05Z, after both evaluation windows were refused, relayed verbatim by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #235, message b1f8d665): „To nie moze tak byc. Znowu bedziemy odrzucac poprawne testy.” Asistant's brief, not his words: this is the priority; with TermAl establish the actual source of both refusals and fix the automatic distinction between correct evidence and a real source change, requiring no silence, no empty turns and no weakening of protection; prepare positive and negative regression cases and a simple end-to-end path with normal work; leave existing evaluations untouched; work autonomously; give a plan and real status.

GREG DIRECT, about 16:06Z, verbatim via Asistant (43498a6e #238, message be5771e9): „Bez workaround i skomplikowanych procedur.” Asistant's brief: applies to the EO repair and false refusals; remove the cause in the product so the normal work cycle runs automatically; no temporary workarounds, empty turns, manual order or new agent procedures; keep protection against a real source change. So the name-then-check one-off used in the first windows isn't repeated, and the next window ask rests on normal work passing end to end.
